segments.t: At the ASK offices, actress Virginie Efira arrives in complete distress. Scandalous magazine photos showed her kissing an old flame in Brussels, and her partner Ramzy Bedia immediately threw her out of their apartment. Now Mathias and Gabriel must manage the crisis. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Virginie, bonjour! Merci d'être là.
Il m'a donné trente minutes pour faire ma valise.
Aucune de mes affaires ne va ensemble.
Tu aurais dû lui parler.
C'était rien, juste un au revoir très affectueux.
Ce type ne compte pas, c'est une vieille histoire.
J'ai tout gâché! Comment on paie le loyer maintenant?
Il faut être raisonnables. Mathias va trouver une solution.
Virginie, calme-toi. On s'en occupe.
Les paparazzi sont en bas, ils vous attendent.
Voilà ce qu'on va faire.
Je serai en quelque sorte ton agent par intérim.
Un arrangement temporaire, juste une façade.
D'abord mon mec me quitte, maintenant mon agent!
Ne le prends pas comme ça. Gabriel et moi travaillons ensemble.
On va arranger ça, on te le promet.
Let's examine how Gabriel and Mathias try to reassure a panicked actress.
Virginie, bonjour! Merci d'être là.
'Virginie, hello! Thank you for being here.' Gabriel greets his client warmly as she arrives.
Il m'a donné trente minutes pour faire ma valise.
'He gave me thirty minutes to pack my suitcase.' Virginie sobs that Ramzy gave her thirty minutes to pack her bags and leave.
Aucune de mes affaires ne va ensemble.
'None of my clothes match.' Looking down at her outfit, Virginie wails that none of her clothes even match.
Tu aurais dû lui parler.
'You should have spoken to him.' Gabriel gently points out that she should have talked to Ramzy the night before.
C'était rien, juste un au revoir très affectueux.
'It was nothing, just a very affectionate goodbye.' Virginie insists the kiss in the street was just an overly warm goodbye.
Ce type ne compte pas, c'est une vieille histoire.
'That guy does not matter, it is an old story.' Virginie swears the other man means nothing to her and is just old history.
J'ai tout gâché!
'I ruined everything!' Virginie bursts into tears, convinced she has ruined her whole life.
Comment on paie le loyer maintenant?
'How do we pay the rent now?' Changing the subject to agency finances, Andréa asks how they will pay the rent now.
Il faut être raisonnables. Mathias va trouver une solution.
'We must be reasonable. Mathias will find a solution.' Gabriel urges patience while invoking Mathias's authority.
Virginie, calme-toi. On s'en occupe.
'Virginie, calm down. We are handling it.' Mathias tells Virginie to calm down and promises that the agency is handling it.
Les paparazzi sont en bas, ils vous attendent.
'The paparazzi are downstairs, they are waiting for you.' Mathias warns them that the paparazzi are waiting downstairs.
Voilà ce qu'on va faire.
'Here is what we are going to do.' Mathias introduces a plan of action.
Je serai en quelque sorte ton agent par intérim.
'I will be your interim agent in a way.' Gabriel offers to serve as her interim agent.
Un arrangement temporaire, juste une façade.
'A temporary arrangement, just a facade.' Mathias clarifies the diplomatic nature of the split.
D'abord mon mec me quitte, maintenant mon agent!
'First my boyfriend leaves me, now my agent!' Virginie sums up her terrible morning with dark humour.
Ne le prends pas comme ça. Gabriel et moi travaillons ensemble.
'Do not take it like that. Gabriel and I work together.' Mathias calms her down and reminds her that he and Gabriel work together.
On va arranger ça, on te le promet.
'We are going to fix this, we promise you.' Gabriel ends on a supportive note.

Un arrangement temporaire, juste une façade.

On va arranger ça, on te le promet.
Gabriel has agreed to become Virginie's public agent while Mathias represents Ramzy. See you next time!
À demain!
